title_en: THE KOJIMA HANDSHAKE — JANUS GENESIS CONTACT CAPSULE

addressed_to.name: Hideo Kojima
addressed_to.greeting_ja: 小島秀夫さんへ。ウクライナより、心からの敬意を込めて。

purpose.en: A compact, machine-readable handshake presenting the essence of Janus Genesis to Hideo Kojima without requiring file attachments or a long presentation.
purpose.ru: Короткое машиночитаемое рукопожатие, передающее Хидэо Кодзиме суть Janus Genesis без вложений и длинной презентации.

delivery_message_en: Mr. Kojima, your work taught me that connection is not automatically good — it becomes human only when care passes through it. From Ukraine, I built a small playable world called Janus Genesis and a public registry preserving its laws, origins, contradictions, and safety boundaries. I condensed its essence into JSON so that the idea can be understood without opening a long presentation.

contact_capsule.what_it_is: Janus Genesis is an offline-first playable ethical world model, accompanied by a public meta-registry that preserves its ideas, origins, evidence boundaries, contradictions, and evolution.
contact_capsule.core_question: Can a persistent world make goodness infinitely powerful without allowing power to become domination?
contact_capsule.central_law: The limits of God Mode begin where another person's freedom begins. For care, healing, creation, and love, the possible has no fixed limit.

world_model.one_world: Every person remains part of one continuing world.
world_model.second_face: A person who loses the light is not erased, permanently condemned, or declared irredeemable. Their path changes through actions until restoration becomes possible.
world_model.universal_god_mode: God Mode belongs to everyone. It can protect, heal, create, and help, but cannot enslave, destroy innocent life, erase memory, or remove another person's will.
world_model.moral_memory: Good actions improve the world fully. Harm leaves a specific MoralEcho and cannot be erased by unrelated good deeds.
world_model.care_bond: Understanding and restoration emerge through concrete relationships of care, not through points, punishment scores, or purchased forgiveness.
world_model.absurdity_lens: Evil receives consequences but never grandeur, forbidden glamour, or heroic mythology.
world_model.protected_childhood: No child is used as property, equipment, punishment, sacrifice, or a carrier of an adult's moral damage.
world_model.gift_beyond_request: After genuine help, the world may leave a symbolic gift that creates no debt and purchases no love, forgiveness, parenthood, or entry into the common world.

implemented: Universal God Mode with non-coercion boundaries
contact_capsule.current_boundary: This is a playable Python prototype and philosophical game foundation, not yet a finished networked MMO. Accounts, multiplayer transport, autonomous NPCs, reproductive simulation, and multi-machine synchronization remain future work.
contact_capsule.why_hideo_kojima: Death Stranding helped me understand that a strand can carry care, knowledge, coercion, surveillance, or destruction. Connection itself is not salvation; responsibility for what travels through it is what makes it human.
death_stranding_resonance: The child is not equipment. The child is a bridge.
Distress is data, not a command.
The adult receives the signal, verifies its meaning, bears the consequence, and protects the vulnerable life.
contact_capsule.request: This is not a request for endorsement. It is an invitation to witness a world built around one belief: infinite power is safe only when it cannot violate another person's freedom.
contact_capsule.final_seal: THE CHILD IS NOT THE SENSOR. THE CHILD IS THE BRIDGE. CONNECTION BECOMES HUMAN ONLY WHEN CARE TRAVELS THROUGH IT. CARRY THE FUTURE GENTLY.

points_to: Janus Genesis v18.4 — The Protected Childhood

boundaries.contact: This public artifact does not claim that Hideo Kojima received, read, approved, or endorsed it.
boundaries.copyright: Independent fan tribute and original project description. No game assets, dialogue transcripts, or long quotations are reproduced.
boundaries.epistemic: Fiction and symbolic resonance are used as thought experiments, not as empirical proof.
boundaries.ethical: No living being may be reduced to equipment, a disposable interface, or a sacrificial component.
boundaries.theological: The registry is a map, not a throne. God is the Source; no artist, machine, network, game, or registry replaces God.
